-- Universal Fly Script (Mobile Optimized & Precision Fixed)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. CLEANUP PREVIOUS RUNS
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("VehicleFlyGui") then
	CoreGui.VehicleFlyGui:Destroy()
end

-- 2. CREATE THE GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "VehicleFlyGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui 

-- --- MAIN FLY UI (TRANSPARENT) ---

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

local plusButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

plusButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 40)
plusButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
plusButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
plusButton.Text = "+"
plusButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
plusButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
plusButton.TextSize = 28
plusButton.ZIndex = 11
plusButton.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", plusButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local flyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
flyButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 40)
flyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 100)
flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
flyButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
flyButton.Text = "Fly"
flyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
flyButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
flyButton.TextSize = 22
flyButton.ZIndex = 11
flyButton.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", flyButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- --- SIDE MENU (MATCHING TRANSPARENCY) ---
local sideMenuFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
sideMenuFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0)
sideMenuFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) 
sideMenuFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100) 
sideMenuFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4 
sideMenuFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
sideMenuFrame.ZIndex = 5 
sideMenuFrame.Visible = false 
sideMenuFrame.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", sideMenuFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- Toggle Button for Side Menu (SOLID / OPAQUE)
local menuToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
menuToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 40)
menuToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0.5, -20)
menuToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 75) 
menuToggleButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0 
menuToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
menuToggleButton.Text = ">"
menuToggleButton.TextSize = 16
menuToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
menuToggleButton.ZIndex = 12
menuToggleButton.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", menuToggleButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local uiListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
uiListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
uiListLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
uiListLayout.Parent = sideMenuFrame

-- Control Variables
local canLookUpDown = true
local isDirectionLocked = false
local lockedLookVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
local rotationOffsetY = 0

local lookToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
lookToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 35)
lookToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50)
lookToggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
lookToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
lookToggleBtn.Text = "Look Up/Down: ON"
lookToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
lookToggleBtn.TextSize = 14
lookToggleBtn.ZIndex = 6
lookToggleBtn.Parent = sideMenuFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", lookToggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local directionLockBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
directionLockBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 35)
directionLockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
directionLockBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
directionLockBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
directionLockBtn.Text = "Lock Direction: OFF"
directionLockBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
directionLockBtn.TextSize = 14
directionLockBtn.ZIndex = 6
directionLockBtn.Parent = sideMenuFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", directionLockBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local rotateBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
rotateBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 35)
rotateBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
rotateBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
rotateBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
rotateBtn.Text = "Rotate Y (+45°)"
rotateBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
rotateBtn.TextSize = 14
rotateBtn.ZIndex = 6
rotateBtn.Parent = sideMenuFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", rotateBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- --- LOGIC & CONNECTIONS ---

-- Side Menu Toggle Function
local menuOpen = false
local function toggleSideMenu(forceClose)
	if forceClose then menuOpen = false else menuOpen = not menuOpen end
	
	if menuOpen then
		sideMenuFrame.Visible = true 
	end
	
	local targetPosition = menuOpen and UDim2.new(1, 10, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	local targetText = menuOpen and "<" or ">"
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(sideMenuFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = targetPosition})
	tween:Play()
	
	if not menuOpen then
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if not menuOpen then sideMenuFrame.Visible = false end
		end)
	end
	
	menuToggleButton.Text = targetText
end

menuToggleButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	toggleSideMenu()
end)

-- Feature Button Actions
lookToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	canLookUpDown = not canLookUpDown
	if canLookUpDown then
		lookToggleBtn.Text = "Look Up/Down: ON"
		lookToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50)
	else
		lookToggleBtn.Text = "Look Up/Down: OFF"
		lookToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
	end
end)

directionLockBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	isDirectionLocked = not isDirectionLocked
	if isDirectionLocked then
		lockedLookVector = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		directionLockBtn.Text = "Lock Direction: ON"
		directionLockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50)
	else
		directionLockBtn.Text = "Lock Direction: OFF"
		directionLockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
	end
end)

rotateBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	rotationOffsetY = (rotationOffsetY + 45) % 360
	local char = player.Character
	if char and not isFlying then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local target = (hum and hum.SeatPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if target then
			target.CFrame = target.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)
		end
	end
end)

-- Mobile Drag Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
end)

mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

-- Minimize Logic
local isMinimized = false
minimizeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	if isMinimized then
		toggleSideMenu(true) 
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 35) 
		minimizeButton.Text = "+"
		menuToggleButton.Visible = false
		
		minusButton.Visible = false
		plusButton.Visible = false
		speedBox.Visible = false
		flyButton.Visible = false
	else
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 160) 
		minimizeButton.Text = "-"
		menuToggleButton.Visible = true
		
		minusButton.Visible = true
		plusButton.Visible = true
		speedBox.Visible = true
		flyButton.Visible = true
	end
end)

-- Universal Flight Logic
local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 3
local bodyVelocity = nil
local bodyGyro = nil
local loopConnection = nil

-- FIXED FLOATING POINT PRECISION HELPER
local function formatSpeed(speed)
	-- Rounds the number to exactly 3 decimal places (e.g. 0.5500002 becomes 0.55)
	return math.round(speed * 1000) / 1000
end

local function toggleFlight()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or not hrp then return end
	
	local targetPart = hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA("VehicleSeat") and hum.SeatPart or hrp
	
	if not isFlying then
		isFlying = true
		flyButton.Text = "Unfly"
		flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
		
		bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		bodyVelocity.Parent = targetPart
		
		bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		bodyGyro.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame
		bodyGyro.Parent = targetPart
		
		local PlayerModule = require(player.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule"))
		local controls = PlayerModule:GetControls()
		
		loopConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then
				if isFlying then toggleFlight() end
				return 
			end
			
			local moveDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			local rawInput = controls:GetMoveVector() 
			
			if rawInput.Magnitude > 0 then
				local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
				local look = camCFrame.LookVector * -rawInput.Z
				local side = camCFrame.RightVector * rawInput.X
				moveDirection = (look + side).Unit
			end
			
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection * (flySpeed * 25)
			
			local baseLook = isDirectionLocked and lockedLookVector or camera.CFrame.LookVector
			
			if not canLookUpDown then
				baseLook = Vector3.new(baseLook.X, 0, baseLook.Z)
				if baseLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then baseLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
			end
			
			local customOffset = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rotationOffsetY), 0)
			bodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPart.Position, targetPart.Position + baseLook) * customOffset
		end)
	else
		isFlying = false
		flyButton.Text = "Fly"
		flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
		
		if loopConnection then loopConnection:Disconnect() end
		if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
		if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
	end
end

-- FIXED SPEED BUTTONS
plusButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	flySpeed = formatSpeed(flySpeed + 1)
	speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
end)

minusButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	flySpeed = formatSpeed(flySpeed - 1)
	speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
end)

speedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local typedSpeed = tonumber(speedBox.Text)
	if typedSpeed then
		flySpeed = formatSpeed(typedSpeed)
	end
	-- This forces the box back to the real number if they type letters by accident
	speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
end)

flyButton.Activated:Connect(function() toggleFlight() end)

scripts.script:
local Target = game:GetService("Workspace") --SELECT YOUR TARGET
local Output = "-- Generated automatically\nlocal create = Instance.new\nlocal refs = {}\n\n"

local blacklist = {
    ["TouchTransmitter"] = true,
    ["Camera"] = true,
    ["Terrain"] = true,
    ["Workspace"] = true,
    ["Status"] = true,
    ["ManualWeld"] = true,
    ["Weld"] = true,
    ["Motor6D"] = true,
    ["Snap"] = true
}

local defaultCache = {}

local function cleanValue(val)
    if typeof(val) == "string" then
        return '"' .. val .. '"'
    elseif typeof(val) == "Vector3" then
        return "Vector3.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "Vector2" then
        return "Vector2.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "CFrame" then
        return "CFrame.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "Color3" then
        return "Color3.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "BrickColor" then
        return "BrickColor.new(\"" .. tostring(val) .. "\")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "UDim2" then
        return "UDim2.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "UDim" then
        return "UDim.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "NumberRange" then
        return "NumberRange.new(" .. val.Min .. ", " .. val.Max .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "EnumItem" then
        return tostring(val)
    elseif typeof(val) == "Instance" then
        return "nil"
    end
    return tostring(val)
end

local function getProperties(className)
    local props = {}
    if className == "Part" or className == "SpawnLocation" then
        props = {"Name", "Size", "CFrame", "BrickColor", "Shape", "CanCollide", "Anchored", "Material", "Transparency", "CastShadow"}
    elseif className == "MeshPart" or className == "WedgePart" or className == "CornerWedgePart" then
        props = {"Name", "Size", "CFrame", "BrickColor", "CanCollide", "Anchored", "Material", "Transparency", "CastShadow"}
    elseif className == "Decal" or className == "Texture" then
        props = {"Name", "Texture", "Face", "Transparency", "Color3"}
    elseif className == "SpecialMesh" then
        props = {"Name", "MeshId", "TextureId", "MeshType", "Scale", "Offset"}
    elseif className == "PointLight" or className == "SpotLight" or className == "SurfaceLight" then
        props = {"Name", "Color", "Brightness", "Range", "Enabled", "Shadows"}
    elseif className == "Sound" then
        props = {"Name", "SoundId", "Volume", "PlaybackSpeed", "Playing", "Looped", "PlayingOffset", "RollOffMaxDistance", "RollOffMinDistance", "RollOffMode"}
    elseif className == "Shirt" then
        props = {"Name", "ShirtTemplate"}
    elseif className == "Pants" then
        props = {"Name", "PantsTemplate"}
    elseif className == "BodyColors" then
        props = {"Name", "HeadColor3", "LeftArmColor3", "LeftLegColor3", "RightArmColor3", "RightLegColor3", "TorsoColor3"}
    elseif className == "Humanoid" then
        props = {"Name", "Health", "MaxHealth", "WalkSpeed", "JumpPower", "HipHeight", "DisplayDistanceType", "HealthDisplayType", "NameDisplayDistance", "RigType"}
    elseif className == "SurfaceGui" or className == "BillboardGui" then
        props = {"Name", "Enabled", "Active", "AlwaysOnTop", "LightInfluence", "MaxDistance", "Size", "StudsOffset", "Adornee", "Face"}
    elseif className == "Frame" then
        props = {"Name", "Visible", "Size", "Position", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel", "BorderColor3", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex"}
    elseif className == "TextLabel" or className == "TextButton" or className == "TextBox" then
        props = {"Name", "Visible", "Size", "Position", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel", "BorderColor3", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex", "Text", "TextColor3", "TextSize", "Font", "TextScaled", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeColor3", "TextStrokeTransparency", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment"}
    elseif className == "ImageLabel" or className == "ImageButton" then
        props = {"Name", "Visible", "Size", "Position", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel", "BorderColor3", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex", "Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "ScaleType", "SliceCenter", "SliceScale"}
    elseif className == "UIAspectRatioConstraint" then
        props = {"Name", "AspectRatio", "AspectType", "DominantAxis"}
    elseif className == "UICorner" then
        props = {"Name", "CornerRadius"}
    elseif className == "UIGradient" then
        props = {"Name", "Color", "Transparency", "Enabled", "Rotation", "Offset"}
    elseif className == "UIStroke" then
        props = {"Name", "Color", "Thickness", "Transparency", "ApplyStrokeMode", "LineJoinMode", "Enabled"}
    elseif className == "UIPadding" then
        props = {"Name", "PaddingBottom", "PaddingLeft", "PaddingRight", "PaddingTop"}
    elseif className == "UIListLayout" or className == "UIGridLayout" then
        props = {"Name", "FillDirection", "HorizontalAlignment", "SortOrder", "VerticalAlignment", "Padding"}
    else
        props = {"Name"}
    end
    return props
end

local function getDefaultValue(className, prop)
    if not defaultCache[className] then
        defaultCache[className] = {}
        local success, defaultObj = pcall(function() return Instance.new(className) end)
        if success and defaultObj then
            local props = getProperties(className)
            for _, p in ipairs(props) do
                pcall(function()
                    defaultCache[className][p] = defaultObj[p]
                end)
            end
            defaultObj:Destroy()
        end
    end
    return defaultCache[className][prop]
end

local idCounter = 0
local opsCounter = 0 
local processedObjects = 0
local totalObjects = 0
local MAX_OPS_PER_FRAME = 1000

local function countObjects(obj)
    if blacklist[obj.ClassName] or obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction") then 
        return 
    end
    totalObjects = totalObjects + 1
    for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        countObjects(child)
    end
end

local function serialize(obj, parentId)
    if blacklist[obj.ClassName] or obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction") then 
        return 
    end

    idCounter = idCounter + 1
    local currentId = idCounter
    
    opsCounter = opsCounter + 1
    processedObjects = processedObjects + 1
    
    if opsCounter >= MAX_OPS_PER_FRAME then
        opsCounter = 0
        local percent = math.floor((processedObjects / totalObjects) * 100)
        print(string.format("Progress: %d%% (%d / %d instances)", percent, processedObjects, totalObjects))
        task.wait()
    end

    Output = Output .. string.format("v = create(\"%s\")\n", obj.ClassName)
    Output = Output .. string.format("refs[%d] = v\n", currentId)
    
    local props = getProperties(obj.ClassName)
    
    for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
        pcall(function()
            local currentVal = obj[prop]
            local defaultVal = getDefaultValue(obj.ClassName, prop)
            
            if currentVal ~= defaultVal then
                Output = Output .. string.format("v.%s = %s\n", prop, cleanValue(currentVal))
            end
        end)
    end
    
    if parentId then
        Output = Output .. string.format("v.Parent = refs[%d]\n\n", parentId)
    else
        Output = Output .. "v.Parent = game:GetService(\"Workspace\")\n\n"
    end
    
    for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        serialize(child, currentId)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    print("Counting objects...")
    for _, child in ipairs(Target:GetChildren()) do
        if not game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(child) then
            countObjects(child)
        end
    end
    
    print(string.format("Objects to serialize: %d. Starting dump...", totalObjects))
    Output = Output .. "local v\n"
    
    for _, child in ipairs(Target:GetChildren()) do
        if not game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(child) then
            serialize(child, nil)
        end
    end
    
    Output = Output .. "table.clear(refs)\n"

    if setclipboard or toclipboard then
        local clipFunc = setclipboard or toclipboard
        clipFunc(Output)
        print("Done! Copied to clipboard.")
    else
        print("Done! Clipboard not supported.")
    end
    
    table.clear(defaultCache)
end)
